title: Schedule of Service Charges Note — The Seasonal Restore Fee on Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
**Charge.** An idle seasonal or irrigation account of Electric Service by Rate Schedule is re-energized on the member's confirmed seasonal restore order, the order being marked completed, and the restore bills one restore fee on the account, billed on the next bill.

**Amount.** The restore fee is the schedule's seasonal restore fee as listed on the seasonal service terms — $45.00 on every schedule.

### Hypothetical cases

| Restore | Restore fee on the next bill |
|---|---|
| Schedule RS lake cabin restored for the summer | $45.00 |
| Schedule IR pivot restored for the pumping season | $45.00 |

### Points of judgement

- One restore bills one restore fee.
- The restore is carried out on the member's own confirmed seasonal restore order, and that order is marked completed with the restore.
